newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran death toll rises to 2,400 - agency.
newsitem.headline: Iran death toll rises to 2,400 - agency.

text.p: The death toll from Iran's massive earthquake rose to nearly 2,400 on Sunday, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said.
The number of injured was 6,000, it said in a report from Mashhad, capital of the quake-stricken northeastern province of Khorasan.
The agency said 2,000 of the dead were from villages around Qaen, 394 from Birjand and two from another town.
It quoted a senior Red Crescent official as saying the relief agency had erected 4,000 tents and sent 3,200 more to other stricken areas.
Rescue operations by 100 teams comprising 700 relief workers were under way in 180 villages, the official said.
The latest death toll came 24 hours after the quake measuring 7.1 on the Richter scale struck just after midday on Saturday.
